summary:
End-to-end testing of the new deal-removal-request workflow and owner-only account deletion for Go Perks. Backend regression (/app/backend/tests/test_deal_removal.py) 4/4 passed under pytest with PYTHONPATH=/app/backend. Frontend flows exercised via Playwright on preview URL:

1) Business portal (test_qa_business@example.com) — /business shows 3 submissions. 'TEST QA Pending Deal' has NO 'Request removal' button (confirmed). 'TEST QA Live Deal' (business-deal-request-removal-<id>) opens window.prompt. Short reason ('ab') -> toast 'Please add a short reason', no state change. Cancel -> no action. Valid reason 'TEST closing' -> toast success + business-deal-removal-pending-<id> pink note appears + approved/LIVE pill still shown.

2) Admin (test_qa_admin@example.com) — sidebar Deals badge = 2 (1 pending + 1 removal request); filter tabs include 'Pending', 'Removal requests 1', 'Live', 'Rejected', 'Removed 0', 'All'. Deal row status pill shows 'removal requested'. Opening the row shows removal-request-box with the reason text 'TEST closing' and the two action buttons. DECLINE with empty note: success toast, box disappears, deal stays live, request cleared.

3) Second request created via POST /api/business/deals/<id>/removal-request (business cookies) -> 200. Admin APPROVED via removal-approve-btn with empty note prompt. Deal moved to 'Removed' tab (deal-status pill = 'removed'). Public /api/deals no longer returns 'TEST QA Live Deal' (sanity: 'TEST QA Second Deal' still present). Deal is NOT deleted from admin list.

4) Staff (test_qa_staff@example.com) — /admin/deals shows no bulk 'Delete' button even when rows are selected. DELETE /api/admin/users/<self> returned 403 'Not allowed'. Expected pass.

5) Owner member-delete UX — Members page, open test_qa_member row -> click delete-account-btn -> prompt (Permanently delete TEST QA member's account?). Typing 'nope' -> toast 'Not deleted — you need to type DELETE'. Member record still present via /api/admin/users?role=member. Did NOT type DELETE to preserve the member fixture.

6) No self-delete anywhere else — /account (member): no 'delete account' text present. /business/profile (business): no 'delete account' text present.

7) Activity log at /admin/activity contains the three expected phrases: 'Asked to remove deal', 'Kept deal live', 'Took deal off the site'.

8) Responsive: /business at 390px scrollWidth == innerWidth (overflow=0). /admin/deals at 1440px overflow=0. Screenshot of business submissions mobile view confirms stacked card layout with no clipping.

All expected behavior verified. No bugs found. Did NOT delete the business account (per test_data_rules — main agent cleans up TEST data; business dialog delete would cascade to deals and is destructive). Removal emails were kept to the minimum — 1 request via UI and 1 via API (the latter gets approved and sends the approval email to example.com which Resend will log as warning per brief).
critical_code_review_comments: RemovalRequestBox is rendered inside the admin deal dialog only when deal.status === 'approved' && deal.removal_requested_at is set. If an admin ever edits a deal that's already status='removed' there's no visible history of why it came off — consider surfacing the stored removal_reason + removed_at in the dialog when status === 'removed'.
Business.jsx requestRemoval uses window.prompt which is OK, but a dialog-based UI with proper validation would be more accessible (screen readers, mobile). Not a blocker.
No rate limit visible on POST /business/deals/{id}/removal-request — after one request succeeds the deal flag prevents duplicates until an admin decides. That correctly blocks spam; good.

success_rate.frontend: All 9 review items passed (business flow, admin decline, admin approve, staff restrictions, owner delete UX, no-self-delete member, no-self-delete business, activity log phrases, 390/1440 layout)

test_credentials: test_qa_admin@example.com / test_qa_staff@example.com / test_qa_member@example.com / test_qa_business@example.com — all authenticate at /api/auth/login (password TestQA!2026).
seed_data_creation: None. Only created removal requests on existing 'TEST QA Live Deal' (approved+removed during test); main agent handles cleanup of TEST data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live deal 'TEST QA Live Deal' (id 6aebecfd7bb444b0d9499719) is now status='removed' after this test run. 'TEST QA Second Deal' and 'TEST QA Pending Deal' remain. If re-testing the removal workflow, create a new approved deal first. Backend test runner: cd /app/backend && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest tests/test_deal_removal.py (pytest.ini uses -n 2 loadscope). Prompts are window.prompt — use page.on('dialog', ...) with .accept('...'). Removal emails go to real SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL inbox; keep requests to minimum. Filter tab labels include counts so use re.compile('^Removal requests') not exact='Removal requests'.
